heading.en: Can a molecule twist without breaking?

hook.en: The two halves of an ethane molecule spin about the carbon–carbon bond millions of times a second. Each position along the way is a conformation.
hook.kn: ಈಥೇನ್ ಅಣುವಿನ ಎರಡು ಭಾಗಗಳು C–C ಬಂಧದ ಸುತ್ತ ಪ್ರತಿ ಸೆಕೆಂಡಿಗೆ ಲಕ್ಷಾಂತರ ಬಾರಿ ತಿರುಗುತ್ತವೆ. ದಾರಿಯ ಪ್ರತಿ ಸ್ಥಾನವೂ ಒಂದು ಅನುರೂಪ.

objectives.en: Draw Sawhorse and Newman projections of ethane
Compare the stability of staggered and eclipsed forms

narration.en: The two halves of an ethane molecule spin about the carbon–carbon bond millions of times a second. Each position along the way is a conformation.
narration.kn: ಈಥೇನ್ ಅಣುವಿನ ಎರಡು ಭಾಗಗಳು C–C ಬಂಧದ ಸುತ್ತ ಪ್ರತಿ ಸೆಕೆಂಡಿಗೆ ಲಕ್ಷಾಂತರ ಬಾರಿ ತಿರುಗುತ್ತವೆ. ದಾರಿಯ ಪ್ರತಿ ಸ್ಥಾನವೂ ಒಂದು ಅನುರೂಪ.

body.en: Rotation about a C–C single bond gives an infinite number of spatial arrangements called conformations. In the eclipsed form the hydrogens on the two carbons are directly behind one another (dihedral angle 0°); in the staggered form they are as far apart as possible (60°). Others are skew forms. Sawhorse and Newman projections show them; a Newman projection looks straight down the C–C bond.
body.kn: C–C ಏಕಬಂಧದ ಸುತ್ತ ತಿರುಗುವಿಕೆಯಿಂದ ಅನಂತ ಅನುರೂಪಗಳು ಉಂಟಾಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಗ್ರಹಣ ರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿ ದ್ವಿಮುಖ ಕೋನ 0°, ಹಂಚಿದ ರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿ 60°. ನ್ಯೂಮನ್ ನಿರೂಪಣೆ C–C ಬಂಧದ ನೇರ ನೋಟ.

points.en: Sawhorse: side view; Newman: end-on view

In the eclipsed form the hydrogens on the two carbons are directly behind one another (dihedral angle 0°); in the staggered form they are as far apart as possible (60°). Others are skew forms.

say.en: In a Newman projection we look along the carbon–carbon bond: front C–H bonds meet at the centre; back C–H bonds start at the circle. In the staggered form the back bonds sit between the front ones.

text.en: yellow: front C–H, orange: back C–H

say.en: As one carbon turns, the energy rises and falls three times per full turn. Eclipsed forms are highest, staggered lowest, about 12.5 kilojoules per mole apart.
That barrier is small compared with the thermal energy of molecules at room temperature, so rotation is almost free and the conformers cannot be separated.

body.en: In the eclipsed form the C–H bond pairs repel most; this repulsion is called torsional strain. The staggered form is the most stable and the eclipsed the least. The energy difference is only about 12.5 kJ mol⁻¹, so rotation is almost free at room temperature and the conformers cannot be separated. Bond lengths and bond angles are the same in all conformations.
body.kn: ಗ್ರಹಣ ರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಂಧ ಜೋಡಿಗಳ ವಿಕರ್ಷಣೆ ಅತಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು: ಇದು ತಿರುಚು ಒತ್ತಡ. ಹಂಚಿದ ರೂಪ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಸ್ಥಿರ. ಶಕ್ತಿ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ ಕೇವಲ ಸುಮಾರು 12.5 kJ mol⁻¹, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಅನುರೂಪಗಳನ್ನು ಬೇರ್ಪಡಿಸಲಾಗದು.

points.en: Conformers interconvert rapidly; they are not isolable

problem.en: During one full 360° rotation of one CH₃ group of ethane, at which dihedral angles do the eclipsed and staggered conformations occur?

steps.en: Eclipsed whenever the hydrogens line up: 0°, 120°, 240°.
So there are 3 eclipsed and 3 staggered positions in one turn.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. During one full 360° rotation of one CH₃ group of ethane, at which dihedral angles do the eclipsed and staggered conformations occur?

problem.en: The staggered form of ethane is 12.5 kJ mol⁻¹ lower in energy than the eclipsed. What is this per molecule? (Nₐ = 6.022 × 10²³ mol⁻¹)

steps.en: Energy per molecule = 12.5 × 10³ J mol⁻¹ ÷ 6.022 × 10²³ mol⁻¹.
This is small compared with the thermal energy available at room temperature, so rotation is nearly free.
